scope: Windowed device CreateDevice/Reset effective geometry and version-specific caller fields only. One resolved size drives host commands, guest default viewport/scissor/surfaces and D3D8 front storage. Preserve existing empty-client fallback (640x480 constructor; prior dimensions on Reset) and unknown-format fallback; these are not new native minimized-window or desktop-format oracles. Completed blocks/private stores, additional-chain normalization, fullscreen zero/refresh/format validation, multiple backbuffers, native Microsoft HAL, game/FPS and stages 4/5/6 remain incomplete.

sources.evidence: Windows create/reset tests: client dimensions when requested zero, count zero becomes one, D3D8 caller dimensions unchanged, D3D9 returned/cached effective dimensions and resolved window.

documentation.fact: For windowed presentation, a zero dimension selects that client-area dimension, and zero count means one.

documentation.discrepancy: The current Reset documentation says returned sizes/count are zero and windowed format UNKNOWN. Pinned Wine Windows tests expect resolved D3D9 sizes/format/count instead; this compatibility step follows those test expectations and does not claim a new Microsoft HAL measurement.
